title: King Vira Alakesvara
biography: Vira Alakesvara (1391–1392) ruled briefly for one year from Gampola. His short tenure marked a transitional phase before the Kotte kingdom's ascendancy. Limited administrative consolidation occurred; regional power dynamics dominated.

content: Vira Alakesvara (1391–1392) ruled briefly for one year from Gampola. His short tenure marked a transitional phase before the Kotte kingdom's ascendancy. Limited administrative consolidation occurred; regional power dynamics dominated.

internationalConnections: Vira Alakesvara ruled Gampola and parts of the south for 14 years, famously confronting a Chinese Ming expedition in 1411.
